talas.t: cannot sleep, the leopard video again 😂
Kayırluu tañ! Talas is clear and cold this morning, mountains white again ❄️
Clear for the whole day they say. Good for the potatoes in the store, no rain
Kayırluu! Going to the Hippodrome later? Irad Cup is tomorrow not today, I keep mixing it up 😅
Not today. Cup is Sat... wait it was Sat, now it's Sunday, the cup was yesterday lol
Yesterday, Neftchi 2-0 would've been nice, instead 2-1 to Tulpar. not complaining 😎
sorry the cup was the 7th, the league was 31 Oct. I'm confusing myself
Morning. Neftchi won the cup 2-0 yesterday, I was right 🐎
Marat you were NOT right, the cup is 14:00 next Sat... I'm lost. Coffee first
Ok, the bus question. Is the 14 running on Sunday or the Sunday timetable? Nurzhan side seems fine
Sunday timetable, so fewer buses. Plan 10 min extra 🙂
Ignore the poll, I meant to post something else
Bars the dog is back to the kiosk, Nurbek, you saw him there?
No, that was last week. Bars is fat now, Gulzada take him to the vet
He eats everything from the Attelkom canteen bins 🙄
Hay in the valleys still 26 a bale. Whoever has spare, ping me, I need 20 bales before the snow
Who sold you hay at 26 when the Chu one is cheaper? Go to Kara-Buura side, they sell from the farms
My horses don't eat Chu hay, they're spoiled. Wrong grass 😤
Old City at breakfast smells of tandyr bread and smoke, i love it 🥖
Nan is 3.50 a loaf at the corner shop now, still jakshı
Air in Talas says 102 on the app, unhealthy for sensitive people. Kids should stay in
My three are coughing since Friday. Doctor says just keep them in the warm room
Sorry Gulzada, hope they feel better soon 💛
Nurzhan is worse, 183 today. Don't go there without a mask
Our branch had a queue of old ladies this morning asking about the pension card. Nice Sunday shift 😅
Lunch at the plov place by the bus station? 28 a plate and they still give bread
Yes if they still have the good meat. Last time it was all bone
Come to the counter after, I fixed a phone for 20 som, wait I mean I'll fix anything, just ask
Changers on Bazar-i Kalan this morning: 11.50 buy, 11.90 sell for dollars. Euro 12.65/13.25. Rubles, 100 is 13.25 buy
Rubles are cheap now. My son in Russia asks me every week to send, hard to see the difference
The bank rate is 8.40 for the dollar, the booths take a cut. Everybody knows, nobody says
Herald wrote about it again, the families who get money from Russia lose a lot in fees
I'm not supposed to say what we charge 🙃 but the Herald is right
Ok, let's not get into remittances on a Sunday 😂 who's coming Thursday?
Tulparcoin is at 3.41 cents today according to the news. Nobody I know can even buy it, lol
Crypto is for Almaty people. I'll stay with the som
Ulak tartysh Kara-Bulak next Saturday, Hippodrome? Marat you coming with the horses
If they are not sold out. Maybe I bring the grey
ISEZ round 10 is the 14th, Talas plays Dastgoh at the State Hippodrome, 21:00 🐎
21:00 is late, I'll come after the bazar
Talas v Dastgoh, we need the points. Two in a row would be good
Anyone else's Tulpar scarf now a bit dirty from the cup? Hahaha
Washed it. Ready for the 14th 🧣
Tulpar sticker here: [sticker: tlpr_up]
Kids asleep, I finally have an hour. Tea?
Tea yes 🍵
Power is normal in Talas today? Lights blinked around 16:00
Blinked here too, then fine. No cut scheduled as far as I know
Heat is on at the block, so good
The Silk Road taxi back to the centre is from 15 som if you share 🚕
Shared taxi, sure. I'll get the grey home from the stables then
Anyone know if the Sunday market at Jibek Jolu reopened? Nurbek's aunt asked
Not yet, court says the fire report is still pending. She's been at home 2 months
Sorry for her 💛 hope the report comes soon
Who wants to practise English on Thursday? I'll bring the flashcards 🇬🇧
Me, dictionary is ready 😂
I'll come, bring boorsok? someone said it's always there
Always 🙂
Anyone watching the Talas Symphony on Saturday? Or is it too cold to go out
Too cold, I'll stay in with tea. Sorry Elnur
Cold is fine, we have heating. Just the air is bad 😷
Petrol AI-92 is 5.40 at my village station. Drove to Talas and back this week, the tank is a lot lighter
Diesel 6.10 for the tractor. Everything is expensive except the nan
Bars just came back from the kiosk with a bag of bread 🙈
Bars has better taste than us 😂
Who saw the snow leopards story? Two on camera in upper Besh-Tash. Still can't believe it
Yes, I said that already last night 😅 they're rare, my grandfather never saw one
No compensation for the herders, the Herald says. That's the part that matters
Herders need to be paid for lost sheep first, then leopards. My view
Both things can be true 🙂
Silk Road Arena tomorrow with the ulak? No, let me check, I think it's the Hippodrome
Hippodrome, Talas v Dastgoh is the 14th, tomorrow there's nothing I know of, just the Sunday
[poll: Thursday exchange: boorsok or plov?]
Boorsok is a classic. Vote 🙂
Boorsok 🐎
Plov, but only if Elnur cooks
Ha, no. Boorsok 🥟
Neftchi won the cup 2-0 so we're all good. Season is 1 point off Neftchi, Tulpar 2nd, one round left 🧣
Last round is 14th? No, the league ended 31 Oct, the table is final. Tulpar second, 62 points
Right, the league is done, 27 rounds. Second place is fine, we had a great year 🧣
Good season for Talas anyway 🙌
Night soon. Potatoes sorted for the winter, thank God
Tınç uyku after this, kids need to sleep too
Good night all, the booth opens early tomorrow 🌙
Tınç uyku 🐎
Night Talas 🌙
Good night 🌙
Night all, fog tomorrow in Nurzhan so stay safe on the road 🌙
cant sleep, horse at the hippodrome has a cough. vet coming at 7
oh no. hope it's just the cold 🙏
he's 20 years old so every cough is a drama lol
Kayırluu tañ. Talas clear this morning, cold on the potato fields 🥔
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on the car again. Scraping for 10 min
Kids are wearing hats in the house already 😂
Morning. Rode the bus in, Talas air is actually better than Nurzhan, Herald says 119 today. still not great though
Booth open. Changers in Bazar-i Kalan at USD 11.45 buy / 11.95 sell this morning if anyone needs dollars
Rate's still fixed at the official 8.40 so the gap is what the changers take. Fine, I suppose 🤷
Everyone asks me why the gap. Not my decision lol
Anyone know if the 14 bus is running? Waiting at Communications Sq
Ran fine at 7:30 I think. Check with the driver
Potatoes at Bazar-i Kalan now 2.10 per kg. Bakyt, your 1.80 sack price is gone 😅
Sack price is only for the big buyers. Those 2.10 are for kilo buyers, okay
Good. I'll buy a sack in Nov then, my uncle says the Kazakh ones are cheaper in Feb
vet came. just a cold. 🐎 gets hay and rest
Thank God 🙏
Did anyone read the Herald piece on the polyclinics? 4.5m for clinics and village health posts
Yes. My sister lives in Kara-Suu, she says the nearest post has no nurse most days. Maybe now it changes
Rahmat for sharing. Hope so
Money is always announced. Post opens when there is a nurse 🤷
Let's be nice Bakyt 😄 at least it's in the news
Anyone here fixing old Nokia? Customer brought one, battery swollen, I told him to bin it lol
Bin it! Those batteries are dangerous. Keep it away from the radiator
My mom still has one that works. Only Nokia that ever survived 😂
[sticker: haha]
Heating is on at work now. Finally warm. Dust in the radiators smells like burning 😅
Ours too. The kids' room smelled for a day. Open the window for 5 min
lunch. plov from the Samsa stall. 28 som a plate, cheaper than last month
Plov at 28 is fine for Talas. Nurzhan's is more
Nurzhan prices go with the refinery smell 😂
Anyone going to the Talas v Dastgoh ulak? Nope, that's the ISEZ football... no wait. I'm confused again 😅
Ulak is at the Hippodrome, the 14th. Football is Tulpar's new season, not till spring I think
Ok ok. Ulak. Good, I'll bring my horse-loving cousin 🐎
Nurzhan air 174 today, bad. Talas 119. Iyık Janyl 153. Who drives to Nurzhan today?
Me, I'm going for a phone part at 4. Mask and window shut 😷
Mask and wait, the inversion means it sits there all day
Kids had to stay in at recess because of the smog. Sad
Are they open windows in the school? We need air filters 😞
Dunno, director says wait for the heating budget. Everyone says wait
Heads up, don't buy 'air filter' ads from random Instagram sellers. Two people were caught in Nurzhan for fake ones. 14 buyers lost 5,900 som
Fake filters, fake heaters. People will buy anything in winter
buy from a shop you can walk into. that's my rule
Remittance families coming to the booth today, asking about the fees. The Herald's View piece is right, they want to see the number between the rates
My cousin in Moscow sends 300 dollars a month, the fee is huge. Shows up in the rate, not the fee
Yes. Honest answer is the spread is the fee, but nobody writes it down
Ulak question: is the Talas v Dastgoh on the 14th at 21:00 or earlier? Sorry I'm new 😅
21:00 at the Hippodrome. Bring a jacket, it's cold after dark
Rahmat. Going to be my first ulak match
first ulak is the best. You'll see the horses come in like the wind 🐎
Ulak round 9 results: Talas beat Semiz 7-5. Good win for them. Chu beat Nurzhan 4-3 too
Yes! Talas are 2nd in the ISEZ table on 22 points. Chu top with 23
Chu had 9 games, Talas 8. Still one to catch 🤞
Is the Tündük café still doing boorsok on Thursday? The exchange is on the 12th
Thursday 12th? It's Thursday 12 Nov, yes. 18:30 as always. Bring a friend 🙂
Ok I'll bring my sister. She speaks better English than me lol
Cold is coming tonight, Talas low 0. Put the potatoes in the cellar cover
Already did. My cellar is full of potatoes and jars 😅
Taxis in Talas from 15 som? Going to Bazar-i Kalan after work, not sure I'll walk in this cold
Marshrutka to Kyzyl-Adyr is 30 som, if you're going out that way. Taxis are 15 minimum
Ok I'll take the taxi. Warm and dry 🙏
Evening all. Is the Fergana road still open for trucks? My brother drives to Ala-Bel
Open, chains or winter tyres needed. Saw the sign at the checkpoint
Tyre shop on the Trans-Talas has chains in stock. Tell your brother 🛞
Ha, of course you do 😂 rahmat
Kids asleep finally. Tomorrow the ulak chat again?
Tulpar season is over, Neftchi champions. Ulak is better at the moment 🐎
Don't say that in front of me 😤 Second place is still good 🧣
Ha. Neftchi won the cup 2-0 over Attelkom too. Final is Saturday 7 Nov, that's done now 😅
Ok the cup was the 7th. Fine. We don't talk about the cup
Tomorrow Bazar-i Kalan has apples from Chu at 3.45 per kg. Good for jam
Apples for jam! Buying 10 kg 🍎
Walnuts in Toktogul are 22 som per kg. Hope someone here sells walnuts 😄
My aunt sells walnuts in Chu, want me to ask?
Yes ask. Tell her Bakyt says hi
Hay in the valleys now 26 som a bale. Horses eat more when it's cold, that's the problem
Poor horses. Marat, you feed yours well I know 🐎
Is the Hippodrome ulak on the 14th free to watch or ticket?
Ticket at the gate, small price. Ask Marat, he knows the stables
Gate ticket. Tell them I sent you, they'll let you see the stables
Irad Cup final is Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom. Sat 7th. Old news now 😅
Enough cup! Kids, the 14th ulak is Talas v Dastgoh 21:00. Say it with me 🐎
Cold tonight in the valleys? Iyık Janyl fog and inversion, I heard
Yes, fog in Iyık Janyl, 3 at low. Stay in tonight 🌙
Tulparcoin is up 8.9% today, somebody said. Crypto nonsense, not legal money 😤
Yeah, not legal tender, don't touch it
Who even has Tulparcoin? I thought it was a joke 😂
My nephew. He's 16 and lost 30 som on it. Don't tell his mother
[sticker: jakshi]
Tınç uyku
Night all, booth opens at 8 tomorrow 🌙
Tınç uyku 🌙
Night Talas 🌙
Night. Fog in Nurzhan tomorrow, I'll take the bus, not my car 🌙
Still up? Night shift at the Talasbank branch tomorrow, 8 to 4. Kill me
Go to sleep Timur 😴
Kayırluu tañ. Minus 2 at the tyre shop door this morning, my hands hurt already
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on all the potato rows, nothing to dig today
Kayırluu tañ! Clear sky, mountains very sharp. Who's taking the 14 today?
I'm on foot, the 14 never comes before 8 for me. Plus the walk warms me up
Trans-Talas lane closure still on? Driver said Monday they'd finish by today
Still there near the North Terminal, cones and one lane. Took 25 min yesterday
Ugh. Rahmat for the heads up 🙏
Hay in the valleys still 26 som a bale. Nobody sells cheaper now, I checked twice
Horses eat like pigs when it's cold lol
Changers at Bazar-i Kalan this morning: USD 11.50 buy, 11.95 sell. EUR 12.70 / 13.30. Bank says 8.40 so nobody cares about that one 😅
Why is the gap so big? Ok I'll stop asking, I'm just a phone guy
Because the bank rate is fixed and the street is not 🤷

poll.q: Who is still buying potatoes at Bazar-i Kalan this week?

talas.t: Auntie says the walnuts from Chu are coming Thursday. Do you want me to get her number? 🥜
Yes, 10 kg for me. Tell her Bakyt, she knows the name
Ok. Walnuts in Toktogul are 22 som, so she says she'll be cheaper than that 😄
Your aunt is a legend Nurbek
Rahmat 😊
Who's coming Thursday to the teahouse? We need more people, last time was just me and two students
I'll come! I'll bring boorsok this time 😅
Yes Rustam!! Jakshı
Kids are asking if they can have snow day at kindergarten. First snow not even here yet lol
Saat toguzda 4 gradus again? It's 0 at the market right now
Frost stays till 10. Potatoes in the cellar are fine, I checked
Tulpar Talas training Sunday. Anyone want to come watch, the field is fine now
Can't, booth is open till 6 on Sundays
I can come, I'm done with the horses by 11
Hey, phone screen cracked on a Samsung, can someone tell me where to get a glass in Talas that's not a scam? 😩
The counter by the Attelkom kiosk, guy named Kanat. Honest, not expensive
You mean... my counter? I'm on the other side of the market lol
Ha, then go to Kanat, he's a friend. Tell him Timur sent you
The air in Talas today is bad, 121 on the index. My lungs feel it already
Children stay in at break now. Mask or no mask, it's just dust and coal smoke
Nurzhan is worse, 153. Rustam you're breathing better here I hope
Yes much better. Nurzhan smells like the refinery, here it's just coal 😅
Heating season on since October. Everyone burns something. I burn wood and I'm not sorry
Lunch at the plov stall, 28 som a plate. Still the best in the bazar
Tell the cook it's still too salty 😂
He says you're a horse, he's not cooking for horses
[sticker: haha]
Anyone watched the Irad League round 27 result? Neftchi still top, Tulpar 2nd by one point
Neftchi 2-1 Tulpar. Last round, we lost but we're still 2nd. Season done
Don't be sad Timur. Next year
Don't talk about the cup either 😤
Ulak on the 14th is Talas v Dastgoh 21:00 at the Hippodrome. Who's going?
I go, my two horses are running in the warm-up. Come see them
Ticket at the gate, right? Last time Elnur said so
Yes gate ticket, small price. Tell them Marat sent you
Did anyone read that the Toktogul reservoir is 85% full? Good for power then 👍
Power is normal in Talas and Nurzhan, no cuts scheduled. Lights on for now
Enjoy it, the power company never says more than that
Anybody going to the Kara-Buura game on the 14th? Football, I mean
Football is at 13:00 Sat? I forgot the schedule lol. Ask Marat, he watches everything
Football and ulak are different games! Ulak is the horses, the 14th is 21:00 Talas v Dastgoh. Kara-Buura plays football, not ulak 😤
Ha! Marat getting cross with us
Ok I'll get the 21:00 ulak, I'll bring Gulzada's nephew, he wants to see horses
Please don't teach him about crypto there lol
[sticker: horse_love]
Who's got a horse-shoe man in Talas? Mine lost one on the road
Ask at the Hippodrome stables, they have a smith on Saturdays
Rahmat Marat
Evening all. Cold out there, I put the stove on. Who's making soup tonight?
Me, lagman with my kids. They keep asking for ice on the window
Hot tea is the only thing I want tonight honestly
Anyone else notice the pass road to Nurzhan is clear? Got a friend who drove it yesterday
Clear, but chains or winter tyres needed on the Fergana Gateway, they said on the radio
Winter tyres. I sell them. Don't drive without, please 🙏
Marat's shop: buy tyres, get a free lecture
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Kech jakshı everybody. Wait, is the Irad Cup final still on the 7th? Already over right, Neftchi won 2-0
Yes, Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom, Sat 7th. We said no more cup 😂
Ok the cup is done, now the ulak league. ISEZ table: Chu top with 23, Talas 2nd on 22
Talas has played 8 though, Chu 9. We could catch them! 🐎
Our horses go on the 14th at 21:00 against Dastgoh. Talas v Dastgoh, only that one
Kids, the 14th is Talas v Dastgoh 21:00 at the State Hippodrome. Write it down
My nephew asked if he can go on the 12th for the play-off semi. Hahaha no, that's December 😂
Play-off semis are on 12 Dec at the Hippodrome, 19:00 and 21:00, right?
Yes, the final is 19 Dec at 19:00, same ground
Tulparcoin is up again? Someone said 3.74 cents. Stop talking about it!!
Not legal money, Bakyt, we agreed 😂
Changers still 11.50 buy for dollars. Booth opens at 8 tomorrow 💵

poll.q: Going to the 14th ulak at the Hippodrome?

talas.t: Rustam, bring the nephew at 20:30, he needs to eat first
Ok, meeting at the gate at 20:30 🙏
Auntie confirmed walnuts, 10 kg for Bakyt. Good ones from Chu 🥜
Rahmat Nurbek 🙏
Plan for Thursday: 18:30 teahouse behind the philology building. Boorsok on Rustam
Yes Aizada 😅
Late shift tomorrow? No, I'm on the 8 to 4. Going to sleep. Tınç uyku
Tınç uyku all 🌙
Lagman for the whole street tomorrow? Gulzada you said you'd share 😄
Only if you bring bread, Elnur. Nan is 3.50 at the corner now 😤
Deal 🍞
Fog in Iyık Janyl again tonight, I heard. Stay warm 🌙
Stay warm everyone. Night Talas 🌙
Night. Still no glass for the Samsung, Kanat tomorrow 😴
Night 🌙
Night all. Kids asleep finally 🌙
Night. Frost tomorrow at dawn, dig nothing 🥔
Tınç uyku 🐎

nurzhan.t: Инверсия никуда не делась. Окна не открывайте, Нуржан сегодня в тумане до обеда
Доброе утро 🌫️ Туман такой, что соседний дом не видно
Доброе утро! На Навбахоре батареи чуть теплые, но хоть что-то 🙂
Андрей, сегодня на смену B. Туман сверху, как молоко. У ворот фонари горят даже днём
Вода на Дастгохе сегодня с 10, по громкоговорителю сказали. Опять
Аибек, ну хоть предупредили. Набирайте заранее
Good morning! The fog is very thick here. Is it always like this in November?
Aigerim, почти всю осень так. Туман с инверсией, потом ветер сдует. Одевайтесь теплее 🧣
Rahmat! I bought a scarf yesterday 🙈
Ребят, кто видел что с ценами на уголь? Соседка говорит опять подорожал
Уголь по району не публикуют, это частные продавцы. Но дрова на Дастгохе точно дороже в этом году
Бензин AI-92 на заправке у Тулпара 5.40, это ещё терпимо
5.40 ок, главное чтобы не выше 🙃
Коллеги, кто сегодня на связи? Нужен заказ лекарств из Талас, к вечеру
Я на работе до 15, потом звони
Herald писал, что в Нуржане два человека задержаны за фейковые рекламы обогревателей. 14 покупателей потеряли 5900 сомов. Жалко людей
Опять эти объявления в чатах. Мне писали про какой-то фильтр за полцены, сразу удалила
Правильно. Если цена слишком хорошая, это не бывает хорошо 😄
[sticker: haha]
Кто из вас читал про Наварбахор, что новые котельные хотят запускать? Газ всё ещё без цены
Игорь, ты как заевший диск. Сегодня воскресенье, дай людям отдохнуть 😂
Это вопрос, не агитация. Сдачу 10 миллионов на котельные никто не отчитал
Игорь, в лаборатории тоже спрашивают про тариф. Я сказала, что это к совету
Is the weather better in Talas? My cousin says it is clear there today
Да, в Талас сегодня ясно, до 11 градусов. У нас в Нуржане туман и 8 днём
Lucky Talas 😄
Талас ясно, а ехать туда в воскресенье как? Маршрутка Нуржан–Талас всё ещё 38?
38 и есть. Ходит от ворот 3 в Талас
Спасибо, Аибек. Вечером поеду к Кубку
Кубок в субботу 7-го уже был? Нет, финал Кубка будет в субботу 7 ноября, мы же ходили
Оксана, финал Кубка был в субботу 7-го, Нефтчи 2:0 с Аттелькомом. Ты там была?
Ой, я перепутала 😅 Это в прошлом субботу, я смотрела по телевизору
Оксана, не путай мне прошлое. Я был на трибуне и помню 😂
Sorry, what is the Irad Cup? Is it like a national cup?
Да, Кубок Ирада. Финал был, Нефтчи выиграл. Теперь Нефтчи и в Кубке, и чемпион
Игорь, финал было в субботу 7-го. Сейчас воскресенье 8-е, он уже прошёл
Thank you! Very clear now 🙏
Коллеги, кто знает, есть ли в Политехе курсы русского в будни? Айгерим спрашивает
Вечерние, по будням. Записаться в деканате, я писал выше
Rahmat! I will go on Monday 🙂
[sticker: jailoo]
Света, это что, вид из дома? 😄
Из прошлого лета, на даче. Сейчас тут туман, и хочется обратно 🙂
В Талас приехал. Ребята, на стадионе ульак, а на завтра в лиге ISEZ что?
Ульак это Джарыш. В ISEZ 9-й тур был в субботу 7-го, а в 10-м в субботу 14-го
Талас на 2-м месте по ISEZ, 22 очка. Чу впереди с 23
Талас тоже хорошо. Посмотрим 14-го в Талас против Дастгоха в 21:00
Дастгох обязательно приедет. Иык-Жаныл против Нуржан в 16:00 в субботу, тоже интересно
Good, I want to see a match in Talas. Is the Hippodrome far from the centre?
Ипподром в Талас не очень далеко, на маршрутке минут 20 от центра
Айгерим, на ипподроме кормят лошадей и пиво 😄 Приходите
Тулпар в Женской лиге подняли? Слышал, что Талас Тулпар сыграл вничью с Академией 2:2
Да, 2:2. В женской лиге Тулпар 23, Университет 22. Девочки почти догнали
Университет выиграл у ФК Иык-Жаныл 3:2 в последнем туре, а Аттелькомаш проиграла Нефтчи 0:3?
Нет, Аттелькомаш выиграла 3:0 у Нефтчи. Не путай, Оксана 😄
Ой, точно. Уже не понимаю, кто с кем 🤦
Тарифы: в Талас такси от 15 сомов, автобус до Нуржана 32, маршрутка 38. Всё как в прошлом месяце
Спасибо, Игорь, полезно
[sticker: horse_love]
В Нуржане на пачку сена, кто держит лошадь, сколько сейчас? Соседка спрашивала
Тюк сена в долинах 26 сомов. У нас в Дастгохе дешевле не будет
Ого. Передам
Кто-нибудь смотрел новости про Талас, Герольд писал про перевод денег из России?
Герольд писал: переводы из России 250–400 млн, семьи жалуются на комиссии и курс. У нас в вахте все так считают
Мы как раз на прошлой неделе Андрею переводили через Талас банк. Курс плохой, в обменнике хуже
В Базаре-и-Калан сегодня утром покупали доллар 11.50, продавали 11.90. Официальный 8.40. Вот и разница
Официальный курс 8.40 с 2008 года, а на рынке 11.50. Сильно
Слушайте, а евро и рубль в Базаре сегодня какие?
Евро 12.65 / 13.25, сто рублей 13.25 / 14.45. Это утренние
Так и живём 😅
Good night soon! Thank you all, I am learning a lot. Your city is very kind 🙏
Айгерим, добро пожаловать к нам! 🙂
Ночи всем, завтра в бухгалтерию к 9 😴
Инверсия до утра, Иык-Жаныл туман с 16 до 6. Окна закрыть

valleys.t: Gn. Frost on the windows already. Sunday, nothing to do but feed the cows
Morning. Fog in Chu so thick I cannot see the shed from the house 😶

Kayırluu tañ. Power was on all night here, so I am happy. Kids came to school with cold hands though

Fergana Gateway open this morning. Chains in the bag, winter tyres on, still slow above the tunnel
Talas–Tash-Kömür run is on time. Hope the Kara-Buura lot don't block the road with their trucks again
Who bought the cellar blocks? Sapar's cousin still has not posted here. Kubat, did he call you?
He called, he is coming on Wednesday to measure. Two cellars this summer, he says the walls hold the cold well
Rahmat. I have 11 tonnes in the shed and the shed is not a cellar
Bakyt, keep the potatoes out of the frost. Put sacks on the floor, not on the concrete
Potatoes at Kyzyl-Adyr still 2.10 a kilo at the stall. Buyers gone quiet since Thursday 🤷
Quiet buyers are the worst kind. Loud ones at least tell you a price
Hay 26 som a bale here now. We bought ours in August, so I say nothing 😏
Mairam, you always say nothing and then you say everything
Walnuts at the bazar still 22 som a kilo. My pupils bring them in bags, they eat more than they sell 😄
[sticker: jakshi]

Poll: best use of Sunday in the valley?
[poll: Sleep, Market, Football on the radio, Cellar digging]
Sleep. Obviously 😴
Ulak on the radio. The dog votes too, he is already at the door
Mother made plov for the whole street, 28 som a plate if you were paying, we are not 😄

Power in Chu this afternoon? Normal on the schedule. Let's see if the evening is kind

Trucks waiting is what I would call normal in November 🙃
Ulak, Chu v Sary-Bulak is on 17 Nov? No, wait, the next round is 14 Nov. Next Saturday, Chu on their plain ground
14 Nov, Chu v Sary-Bulak, 17:00 on our ground. Yes. Come and shout, Kubat, but bring your own tea

Frost starting. Apples in Chu 3.45 a kilo at the stall, we have sold 2 tonnes, the rest are for the cows 🍎

Night is coming. Gn soon. Keep the stove in, Sapar, not your box, ours 😄

Walnuts 22, potatoes 2.10, hay 26. Somebody tell me something good before bed

The Gateway is open for the night, chains needed above the tunnel. Drive slow, the women's team is at home on Monday 😄

[sticker: bilbeim]

Ulak Chu v Sary-Bulak on the 14th, I will be there. Bring the thermos, Mairam

Gn. Salam to the sack and the dog. Kayırluu tañ

Lunch: plov from Mother's pot, leftovers from yesterday, still good 🙂

Sary-Bulak 7 pts this season, we are not going to win, but we are going to shout

Both sides of the valley are sad. Good, it means the ulak is alive

Tulpar still second in the league, 62 pts. Neftchi 63, one point, the last round is done so no more chances

Apples in Chu 3.45 at the stall, the rest for the cows. Mairam, cows still lucky?

Lights out on our street again, 10 min. Sapar, I know, not the schedule, the line. Gn soon

Kara-Buura stove smoke again, the whole street smells like coal. Curtains are done

Potatoes 2.10 a kilo, I bring 10 kilo. Fair trade

Chatkal village again, diesel at 8.55 to 9.75 in the villages, my cousin says. Why up there and not here?
Long roads, small tanks, the truck comes once a week. Ask the Chatkal driver, not me
Marshrutka Kyzyl-Adyr–Talas still 30 som. Going at 9 tomorrow, the dog comes too

Gn Sapar. Bus at 9 tomorrow for Nurzhan, scarf on
Gn. Salam to the sack and the dog. Kayırluu tañ

Brr. Our stove is lit since 5, the classroom is warm at least 🙂

[sticker: rahmat]

Reminder for everyone with a foal: check the blanket fit, rubs under the chest cause bad sores

Anyone else's hands freezing at the bazar? Plov still 28 a plate and I am still eating it 🍚
Lunch is getting expensive but you keep coming back 😄

Kyz kuu practice in the Hippodrome yard at 17:00 if anyone wants to watch. Bring a scarf, it is cold 🧣

Hay in the valleys still 26 a bale. Apples in Chu 3.45 a kilo if anyone wants to feed the horses something sweet 🍎
Apples for the horses, walnuts for me 😂 Toktogul bazar is 22 a kilo

Doctor is always right 🙏

Photos from the chabysh! Our mare second, the colt is at home 🐴📸

Highland round 10 this Saturday. Kökjal v Naiman at 13:00 in the basin, Naiman are sitting pretty

Typical. Rahmat doctor 🙏

Toktogul down 39 million m³ in one day? The reservoir people must be watching it every hour

Anyone going to the Chu ground on Saturday for Chu v Sary-Bulak at 17:00? Ulak is my favourite thing to watch in the cold

Rahmat Askat 🙏

Winter tyres for the Ala-Bel road? The pass is open but chains required, Marat, you should sell a lot

Rahmat! My uncle will be happy to hear that

Round 10 ISEZ, Talas v Dastgoh at 21:00 at the Hippodrome, we will be there. Talas need the points

Yes, Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom. Ask Temir, he still cries about it 😂
I do not cry. I am a horse man
Walnuts in Toktogul bazar are 22 a kilo again, I already told you all 😂
Night soon. If the colt has a cough tomorrow, bring him to the Centre by the Talas Hippodrome, morning clinic
Ooba doctor, he's fine, asleep already 😴

diaspora.t: Morning from London ☕ Sunday, the one day I don't set an alarm and then I do anyway
Morning! Mom says Talas is clear today, 11 degrees. Sounds like a dream from here 😭
Berlin is grey and wet. Not even a snow leopard to look at 😂
Novosib -18 this morning. Dad sends photos of the Nurzhan fog, I send photos of my car under snow. We are even 🥶
Did you see the cotton story? 41,000 tonnes, biggest since 2007. Uncle says the ISEZ fields had a good year
Good news. My mom will want cotton stories now instead of the weather 😄
Kids asked me what cotton looks like. I sent them a photo of the Talas valley in August lol

Lunch break. Thinking about kümöch again 🙃
Same. Tried to make beshbarmak with supermarket lamb, my flatmate asked if I was sad 😂
Jasil update: bought one pack for me and one for the neighbour who asked if I was American, peace offering 😅
Fog in Nurzhan again per my cousin. 183 on the air index. He says you can taste it
Tell him to stay in. Mom says the same, she has been wearing the mask at the bazaar 😷
Question for anyone who sends money home: is the Bazar buying rate 11.50 for dollars right now or did it move?
This morning 11.50 buy, 11.90 sell. Official is still 8.40 and nobody uses it 🙃
Euro sell at 13.25 at Bazar. Official cross is 9.37. The gap is bigger than my rent
Ha. Forget the gap, my question is who wins the play-offs. Neftchi and Tulpar both in the top two, Hippodrome in December
Ulak fans are going to be unbearable in December 😂 Ask the Kara-Bulak people
Quiet day here. Waiting for the E-9 office, again 🙃
Found walnuts at a Turkish grocer for 22 som a kilo, the Toktogul price. Feel like I'm robbing someone
Mom says walnuts are cheap in Toktogul this year, they'll post me a bag if I ask nicely
Toktogul still going down. 85.7% now, my dad checks it every evening with the tea
Tell him not to worry, the reservoir had worse years. Or tell him I said so, he trusts Chicago 😄
Anyone flying to Talas in December? Istanbul still cheaper than Almaty flights for me
Istanbul for me too. The Almaty bus is 2 days with the border. Baarıñarga jakshı jol 🥲

Me, on the stream at 7am again 😅 Neftchi won the cup last week already, they are hard to stop

Every time! That's why I check the rate before I press send
Talasbank SMS, Kazakh service, same question. Always compare first, the number between the rates is the real one
Tulparcoin at 3.41 at noon, -0.3%. Dad says that's nothing. Mom says don't buy 😂
Did the Chu v Nurzhan result come through? Nurzhan 3-4 Chu, right? Was that Round 9 on Saturday
Yes, 4-3 to Chu, my cousin was there. Nurzhan lost it in the last minutes 😤
Semiz lost 7-5 to Talas too. Poor Semiz, two points all season
Night is coming here. Baarıñarga jakshı jol, üygö kaytkım kelet 🥲
Night all 🌙 Dad says he's going to check Toktogul one more time before bed
Night! Sleep well Dinara's dad 😄
Night ❤️
Night, everyone. Talas trip in December or not, I'm still deciding 😂

Yes! Finally someone says it. The fee is hidden in the rate, not on the receipt
